en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a well‑dressed man seated at a small round table, a woman in an ornate dress and large hat standing beside the table, and a greyhound‐type dog in the foreground. They appear to be in an elegant, early‑20th‑century interior with paneled walls and simple wooden chairs. Swedish text identifying the scene and publisher is printed on the image.
